programme_name: Master’s degree in International Economics and Business

admission_routes.notes: ESSE3 eligibility assessment and enrolment after positive verification.
EU-equivalent route where applicable; foreign qualifications require International Student Desk assessment.
International call for eligible non-Italian foreign-degree holders not resident in Italy, followed by Universitaly.

academic_requirements.summary: A three-year degree/diploma or suitable foreign qualification is required. The latest indexed programme-specific curriculum rules require 12 CFU in statistics/mathematics and 48 CFU across the specified economics, statistics, business, law, mathematics, science, engineering and social-science sectors, with up to 10% tolerance if 60 CFU overall is met; personal-preparation assessment follows the economics-programme rules. For the 2026/27 international call, applicants need a Bachelor in Economics or a closely related Economics, Business Administration or Statistics field, at least 12 ECTS in Mathematics and Statistics, 48 ECTS in Economics/Statistics/Business Administration, degree awarded by 30 June 2026, and CGPA at least 80% of maximum.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: Suitable foreign Bachelor-equivalent; international-call field requirement is Economics or a closely related Economics, Business Administration or Statistics field.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: International-call wording; programme page uses SECS-S/01-06 and MAT/01-09.
International-call wording; the programme page publishes a broader SSD list for ordinary eligibility.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: International pre-admission call: CGPA equal to or greater than 80% of the obtainable maximum grade. Regular-route personal-preparation threshold appears to follow the economics-programme 22/30 rule [uncertain].
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: Curricular-credit and personal-preparation verification by the programme committee; international call separately assesses eligibility and ranks qualified applicants.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: No overall degree-programme quota was found. International-call ranking and benefits are separate from an overall admission cap; results are communicated within 45 days and the benefit ranking follows the call rules.

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: Published by the international-call evaluation framework; exact programme-specific weighting not isolated [uncertain]

selection_components.notes: Programme personal-preparation check and/or international ranking may require interview.

language_requirements.summary: Certified English proficiency at CEFR B2 or a previous degree taught in English is accepted for the international call. The programme's ordinary requirements also require at least B2 English.
accepted_language_certificates: Certificates in UNIVR's official equivalence list
certificate_exemptions: Previous degree taught in English (international call)
language_requirements.notes: Duolingo is accepted under the international call only for applicants from Iran and Afghanistan.

required_documents.condition: If the Bachelor lasted two years, include the Master's degree too.

tuition_amount_basis: University contributions are generally income-based using ISEEU/ISEE-equivalent calculations; international-call scholarships or €1,000 flat-rate benefits may apply.

double_degree_options.notes: Double-degree mobility, separate from initial admission.
